title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16
lineage: MAC (modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape, about 20 feet in front of the soundboard) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta

ai_review.summary: Decent but non‑soundboard recording of a solid 80s Warfield show; some listeners praise the crisp live feel while others note muffled band mix and Dolby processing.
ai_review.review: The performance is generally regarded as a good representation of the Dead’s 1980s era, with fans noting strong set energy despite an over‑abundance of cowboy‑type songs. Recording quality is mixed – it isn’t a true soundboard capture, showing audience bleed, occasional analogue hiss and questionable Dolby processing, yet some hear a surprisingly crisp live vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (3 / 5) combined with divergent comments on sound quality and show strength yields a modest overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not a true soundboard; listeners report decent clarity but also muffled band mix, analogue hiss, and possible Dolby processing that colors cymbal decay.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 80s Warfield set with a lot of cowboy‑styled numbers; overall solid but not exceptional.
